title: Defusable TNT
description: Defusable TNT via means of Water Bottles, and their splash and lingering counterparts
body: This server-side mod allows for players to defuse TNT, as well as TNT Minecarts and TNT Sulfur Cubes, by right-clicking on them with Water Bottles! Hitting these entities with the effect cloud of a Splash Water Bottle or a Lingering Water Bottle does the same. Or, hand any of these items to an Allay to watch it run over and defuse these things for you
